I offer countless thanks to Jesus and my Mother Mary. Beyond gratitude, throughout this entire lifetime I remain indebted to my Jesus and my Mother Mary.
The first time I came here was in February. I am here to speak about the healing of my mother’s illness.
The first time I came here was in February. The reason for coming here for the first time was that my mother had a rare illness.
We do not know the name of the illness, nor do we know what illness it is. There is no medicine for it.
What was said about the illness is that it is a mental disorder.
She was always confused. At times, she would not remember anything she said, would not remember anything she did, would not know what to say, and would not know what to do.
She could not eat food; the food would not go down. Likewise, my mother would not even swallow her saliva.
For 22 years, she has been taking one medicine. She could eat food only because of that medicine. If the medicine was missed even for one day, she would not eat.
Even when saliva came, she would spit it out. That was the kind of illness she had.
Even today, doctors have not been able to identify what the illness is.
Without knowing what the illness was, we continued in great distress, giving that medicine continuously for 22 years.
By the time February came, my mother fell sick again. She lost her memory completely and stopped eating.
For one week, she did not eat anything. Even when saliva came, she kept spitting it out. Then our aunt (my mother’s elder sister) said for the first time,
"Daughter, let us take your mother and go near Mother Mary at Kreupasanam. Let us take her there and see. This is the last way left; there is no other way.”
Even when we take her to doctors, whenever they examine her, they send her back saying there is no illness at all.
So we thought, let us go and try this as well.
The one we call our aunt is my mother’s twin sister. They look exactly alike, are the same age, and were born with only a five-minute difference.
It was this aunt who brought us here for the first time. On the day we came, I came thinking that my mother would receive Father’s laying on of hands.
But when we came here and enquired at the office, we came to know that only those who have taken the Covenant receive Father’s laying on of hands.
